back.hook: Blessing runs both ways, and it starts with God.
paragraphs: A benediction comes down: God speaks good over His people and lays His own name on them. A doxology goes up: the creature gives glory back to the Giver. Blessing is the hinge between them, and one Hebrew word, bārak, carries the traffic both ways.

Twelve weeks trace that circuit, from the shining face over a camp in the wilderness to every creature blessing the Lamb at the throne. You do not climb up to earn it. You receive the blessing that has already come down.
items: A Scripture Study Dive essay and the full passage in the World English Bible
Five passages, each with a Hebrew or Greek word study and a Live It response
Five Life Application practices and a daily prayer
A Bottom Line and a “Lift Up Your Eyes” benediction
